scripts.setup: git clone --depth 1 --branch v4.5.2 https://github.com/jackyzha0/quartz.git .quartz && npm --prefix .quartz ci
scripts.build: test -n "$QUARTZ_CONTENT" && cp quartz.config.ts .quartz/quartz.config.ts && cd .quartz && npx quartz build -d "$QUARTZ_CONTENT" -o ../public && cd .. && node scripts/sanitize-public.mjs
